=== create existing
participant A
create A
A -> B
=== self activation
A -> A ++ : self
A -> A -- : self back
A -> A ++
activate A
=== self with life events
A -> A
activate A
deactivate A
destroy A
=== embedded diagram in note
participant A
note left of A
{{
B -> C
}}
end note
=== embedded json in note
participant A
note over A
{{json
{"a": 1}
}}
end note
=== creole note
participant A
note left of A
  * bullet
  ** sub
  |= a |= b |
  | c | d |
  ----
  <color:red>red</color>
end note
=== emoji names (escaped)
"😀" -> B : 😀 smile
=== skinparam footbox show
hide footbox
skinparam footbox show
A -> B
=== participant then message with display
participant "Display A" as A
A -> "Display A" : not the same
=== code with quotes inside
"A ""quoted"" B" -> C
=== tabs and indentation
	participant A
		A -> B : indented
	note left of A
		indented note
			deeper
	end note
=== legend creole
legend
|= Key |= Value |
| a | b |
endlegend
A -> B
=== title with newline
title Line1\nLine2
A -> B
=== header with newline
header Line1\nLine2
A -> B
=== deep nesting
alt 1
alt 2
alt 3
A -> B
end
end
end
=== else after end
alt 1
A -> B
end
else x
=== partition end
partition p
A -> B
end
=== activation on group end
alt x
A -> B
end
deactivate B
=== box with stereotype and color
box "B1" <<Grp>> #lightgreen
participant A
end box
=== box name without quotes
box My Box Name #red
participant A
end box
=== participant order with box
box "b"
participant C order 2
end box
participant A order 1
participant B order 1

=== multicast existing
A -> B & C
B -> A & C & D
=== message with only colon

=== participant keyword as name

end -> participant
=== divider with equals
== a == b ==
A -> B
=== delay with colon
... wait: 5 min ...
A -> B
=== hspace large
||1000||
A -> B
=== ref with url only
ref over A [[http://x.com]] : t
=== return twice
A -> B ++
return a
return b
=== destroy with activation
A -> B ++
destroy B
=== activate deactivate on other
A -> B
activate C

=== note left of quoted alias
participant "Long" as L
